title: Eastham, Wellington Place, Ballsbridge, Dublin 4
description:
**Available Immediately****Unfurnished**Sherry FitzGerald Lettings are delighted to present Eastham, 13 Wellington Place — an exceptional four bedroom, three bathroom residence extending to approximately 354 sqm. This elegant home offers generous proportions, refined finishes, and superb privacy throughout. The ground floor features two impressive reception rooms with high ceilings, period fireplaces, and an adjoining study/office. Accommodation includes four double bedrooms, three of which are ensuite, with two located on the upper level and two at basement level.
The open plan basement level hosts a fully fitted kitchen with marble countertops, an American style fridge/freezer, dishwasher, washing machine, dryer, and a dedicated wine cellar. A separate external entrance provides convenient access. To the rear, a sunny southeast facing garden offers excellent privacy and low maintenance landscaping. The property further benefits from a large gated driveway with secure electric gates and parking for up to five cars. A viewing is highly recommended to appreciate this luxury home.
